title: Getting to yes with Iran
gist: Yglesias answers a mailbag question on the Iran war and says Trump must resolve it himself. Since 2018, when the JCPOA was torn up, Iran has seen U.S. agreements as non-credible, especially from Democrats, so a President Newsom in 2029 would struggle to strike a deal. The war is very costly for Iran, though, which creates some incentive to settle. The preview cuts off before the proposed 'least bad' deal.

insights.claim: Yglesias argues Trump himself needs to fix the Iran war, because if it lingers two more years and becomes a Democratic president's problem (he names Gavin Newsom), it will be very hard to resolve.
insights.speaker: Matthew Yglesias
insights.so_what: A long-running war means persistent energy-supply risk through 2029.
insights.quote: if the war somehow lingers for two more years and it becomes President Gavin Newsom’s problem, it’s going to be very challenging to resolve

insights.claim: The stalled diplomacy probably helped motivate the 10/7 attack, which scuttled efforts to build a regional anti-Iranian coalition.

insights.claim: Iran does not want to negotiate with Democrats at all: it knows a Democratic administration is unlikely to bomb it but also cannot make agreements that last, so Biden-era deadlock will return in 2029.

themes.theme: War costs and the incentive to settle

insights.claim: The war is hurting Iran far more than the U.S.; Americans are angry about expensive diesel, but conditions in Iran are much worse, which gives Iran an incentive to resolve it.
insights.speaker: Matthew Yglesias
insights.so_what: High U.S. diesel prices are a live macro effect, and pain on Iran's side is a possible catalyst for de-escalation.
insights.quote: if you think Americans are mad about expensive diesel, things are much worse over there

insights.claim: Yglesias calls the 2026 U.S. attack on Iran clearly a mistake and says Iran does not want to return to the previous status quo.
insights.speaker: Matthew Yglesias
insights.so_what: No easy return to the pre-war setup, so expect prolonged uncertainty.
